thread:
lena: Idea: regional grace-windows for reserved pools so when a region hits contention we apply prioritized soft-drain by customer-tier instead of global FIFO.

mira: Good for enterprise customers worried about cross-tenant noisy neighbors. What are the priority signals? tier, recent_commit_level, active_sessions?

lena: Priority signals: customer_tier (Enterprise/Standard), recent_commit_pct (30min), and manual override flag. Config could look like: `grace_window_secs, priority_weights, tier_preserve_pct`

ryan: Impl note: need a region coordinator to compute drain order and a scoring fn. Keep decisions local for latency but checkpoint weights centrally.

jamal: Ops notes: add alerts for grace_window_started(region), preserve_violation_detected and a playbook to escalate if SLOs across region degrade. Also need a visual in Console showing preserved capacity by tier.

mira: Launch checklist: pilot with 2 regions, 1 enterprise customer, metrics: eviction rate down >=30% for preserved tiers, no >10% tail latency regressions for other tenants. Finance: confirm pricing language for priority preservation.

finance-bot: FYI: Need product code for tiered-preservation SKU, opened FIN-1301.

lena: Owners: @lena product spec, @ryan runtime coord, @jamal oncall/runbook, @mira pilot criteria. I'll draft RFC and attach a small sim for scoring fn.

mira: Please include a 'safety cap' so preservation can't exceed X% of regional capacity. Otherwise risk starving others.

lena: Agreed — default safety cap 40%, configurable. Will add to RFC.
